HIV-1 persistence is a dynamic phenomenon that can be studied in cell line models; cell type and activation status determine the pattern of HIV-1 persistence; HIV-1 proviral DNA is highly mutated in persistent cell lines; and the pattern of persistence in cell lines can be related to mutations in the virus and to cell type.

the study of the mechanisms of persistence of HIV-1 in chronically infected cells and the molecular basis of the viral persistence pattern.
the study of the mechanisms that allow the virus to persist in the host, and the identification of new targets for the development of new therapeutic strategies.
